# Token.name, symbol and decimals: every AddToken handler calls Bank.getTokens() at the event's block
# and copies the entry whose address matches. views/20-token.sql decodes these rows.

[[calls]]
name = "bank_v1_get_tokens"
on = "bank_v1__add_token"
contract = "0xc7130b9d454243be816b7f5ab09e7ef292b0c465"
